Reuters, 27 July 2026 — Zelensky visits Britain, meets new PM Burnham:
- Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky was the first foreign leader received by PM Andy Burnham since he took office a week ago.
- Burnham: "Britain stands with Ukraine, shoulder to shoulder, and our support remains unwavering."
- Britain announced the transfer of intellectual property rights for the British electronic-warfare system "Stone Cloak," allowing Ukraine to produce the technology independently; tablet-sized jammers hinder Russian air defences from tracking drones/missiles in flight.
- Burnham and Zelensky met about 200 Ukrainian military personnel and sailors who spent three weeks in Britain on a maritime-security and counter-mine exercise to prepare for Black Sea missions.
- UK support for Ukraine has reached GBP 25 billion ($33bn) since Russia's February 2022 invasion, including GBP 16 billion in direct military aid.
- Visit came ahead of Zelensky's trip to Washington on Tuesday.
